name: Unblur (FLUX1.D)
description: Attempts to unblur the background of flux images somewhat, it's not fully sharp, but makes the blur more realistic, use strengths from 0.1 to 1.2, experimental. use unblurred background in your prompt. It will not always make the background fully sharp, but instead it uses more appropriate, lesser blur for things like portraits, and reducing it fully on things like selfies, etc.
